title: P36 — measurement integrity, attainability/capture decomposition, and power-aware promotion

measurement_defect.detail: calendar.sessions() (exchange_calendars XKRX 4.13.2) returns 2125 sessions for 2018-01-02..2026-08-27 while the silver ETF panel and the KRX index panel both observe 2123. The two extra dates are genuine KRX holidays the packaged calendar does not know.
measurement_defect.ledger_repro: transition_portfolio_state(prior=cash 50,000,000 + 9,500sh@100,000, intent=target 0.95, opens={}, closes={}) returns equity_close=1,000,000,000 while retaining shares={'X':9500}; next-session equity at open 100,000 = 1,950,000,000 (+95% from nothing). HOLD intent on the same session returns equity_close=50,000,000 (-95%).
measurement_defect.observed_impact: P27 run 20260904T050718Z: +92.96% on 2026-06-04 and +30.08% on 2026-07-20, both the first real session after a phantom session. 60 of 2090 windows contaminated; they supply 24.3% of all P(R>50%) hits. Corrected: P(R>30) 0.0866->0.0857, P(R>40) 0.0651->0.0546, P(R>50) 0.0493->0.0431, terminal wealth 16.81x->3.88x.
measurement_defect.replication: A faithful replica of the P27 decision->next-open-fill loop on the observed-session grid reproduces the production engine's daily returns exactly for 2018..2025 (corr=1.0000, 0 differing sessions); the only divergence is 2026 and it is attributable to the phantom-session artifact.

opportunity_collapse.detail: Under the production capacity envelope (single 95% position, 1% participation, 1.0B KRW) the required ADV is 100.0B KRW, leaving 1.15-1.95 eligible +2x instruments per session for 2018-2025. 88% of P27's invested sessions are KODEX 레버리지 or KODEX 코스닥150레버리지 — the ranker ranks a set of size ~1.
opportunity_collapse.tournament_window_oracle: At the first session on/after Sep 21 the eligible +2x count was 1-2 in every one of 2018..2025. Perfect-foresight best terminal return over that set: -20.0%, +19.0%, +16.3%, -8.0%, +14.4%, +0.3%, -14.2%, +32.1% — the +40% target was unattainable in 8 of 8 historical tournament windows.

evidence.search_exhaustion: Approximately 75 structurally distinct variants (momentum horizon 5/10/20/40/60, min_gap, min_hold, forced holds 5/10/20/36, absolute-momentum cash gate on/off and hysteretic, entry bars, rv_20 volatility tilt, k=1/2/3, inverse -1x/-2x inclusion, four capacity envelopes from 100.0B down to 15.8B KRW required ADV, and clock-aware within-episode variance policies at theta=0.40/0.50/0.60) all land in full-sample P(R>40%) in [0.031, 0.064]. The single variant that exceeds 0.060 does so by locking at the target and collapses P(R>50%) to 0.011, which the championship weights [0.1,0.25,0.45,0.2] penalise. No alpha change inside this architecture reaches the tournament objective.

capture_decomposition.discrimination: On the attainable subset the candidate spread is 0.463 (mom_20) to 0.617 (no cash gate) — a 15pp spread on n=188 — versus a 1.7pp spread on the unconditional metric at n=2088. Candidates are being judged on a factor (attainability) they do not control, which is the mechanical explanation for the P28..P35 rejection history.

candidate_measured.name: sticky.mom60_vol_hysteresis
candidate_measured.change: abs-momentum exit bar -0.10 instead of 0.0 (hysteresis) + rv_20 percentile-rank tie-break at weight 0.5
candidate_measured.honesty: This is a +3.2pp capture improvement inside the 5% ruin cap, not a step change. It is included so the new gate has a live candidate; it does not by itself reach the tournament objective.

assumptions: The silver ETF panel and the KRX index panel are the ground truth for whether a date was a trading session; the packaged exchange calendar is an upper bound that must be intersected with observation (extends INV-2 from row-count-vs-price-ratio to the session grid itself).

Capacity, cost, and exposure parameters are unchanged: max_order_to_adv stays at the configured participation, effective gross stays <= 1.90 for sticky strategies, min_cash stays 0.05. No invariant is relaxed by this contract.

Attainability is computed over the candidate's own declared vehicle universe (the instruments its alpha filter admits) intersected with the PIT deployment universe, so it is a strategy-relative ceiling, not a global oracle. It is PIT-observable at decision time and is not a date or era covariate.
Capture is reported per threshold in {0.30,0.40,0.50,0.60}; a threshold with fewer than min_attainable_windows attainable windows reports null, never 0.0.

requirements: R1 (INV-2 extension, fail-closed): resolve_session_grid returns only calendar sessions that have at least min_rows panel rows. Every dropped date is returned in SessionGrid.phantom and MUST be logged once as '[DATA] gate=phantom_session date=... status=DROP'. A panel date that is not a calendar session is NOT added — the grid is the intersection, never the union.

R2 (equity conservation): transition_portfolio_state MUST NOT produce a state whose marked equity exceeds prior equity by more than the session's realised price move. When is_priceless_session(prior_state.shares, opens) is True the session is treated as HOLD: shares and cash carry unchanged, equity is marked with carry_forward_marks(shares, closes, opens, prev_closes), session_return is 0.0, no fills, no turnover, no cost.
R3: carry_forward_marks returns, per held ticker, the first finite positive price found across the supplied maps in order; a ticker with no finite price in any map is omitted (never priced at 0).
R4 (no silent equity drop): equity marking MUST use carry_forward_marks so that a held position missing from today's close map is valued at its last observed price rather than dropped from equity.

R5: window_opportunities computes, for each window start s (a session index i), the best next-open(i+1) -> next-open(i+1+horizon) return over candidates_by_session[sessions[i]]; breadth is the count of candidates with both endpoint prices finite and positive. A window with breadth 0 yields ceiling None. Windows whose end index exceeds the session range are not emitted.

R6: capture_rate(window_returns, opportunities, threshold, min_attainable) counts attainable windows as those with ceiling is not None and ceiling > threshold; it returns (None, n) when n < min_attainable, and otherwise (mean(window_returns[attainable] > threshold), n). It MUST NOT return 0.0 for an empty attainable set.

R7: attainability_curve returns {threshold: fraction of emitted windows whose ceiling is not None and > threshold} for each requested threshold; windows with ceiling None count in the denominator, never the numerator.

R8 (power gate): resolve_promotion_status returns 'INSUFFICIENT_POWER' when n_effective_discordant < min_effective_discordant, regardless of the three status strings; otherwise 'PROMOTE' when all three are 'PASS' and artifact_integrity is True; otherwise 'RESEARCH_ONLY'. INSUFFICIENT_POWER MUST NOT be treated as promotable, and MUST NOT be reported as FAIL.

R9: discordant_window_mask marks window i True when candidate_holdings[j] != incumbent_holdings[j] for at least one j in [i, i+horizon); both sequences must be the same length or ValueError is raised.

R10: is_promotable keeps its current signature and behaviour and MUST delegate to resolve_promotion_status with n_effective_discordant defaulting so that existing callers are unchanged (backward compatible).

R11: apply_abs_mom_cash uses the bar getattr(config, 'abs_mom_exit', 0.0) when the strategy currently holds a position and 0.0 when it is flat, so the exit bar is hysteretic. abs_mom_exit MUST be <= 0.0; a positive or non-finite configured value fails closed to 0.0 (current behaviour).

R12: summary.json gains 'attainability' ({threshold: float}), 'capture' ({threshold: float | null}), 'n_attainable' ({threshold: int}) and 'breadth_mean' (float); runs.parquet gains capture_40, capture_50, attainable_40 and breadth_mean columns. Existing keys and columns are unchanged.
R13 (no invariant relaxed): effective gross exposure, min_cash, single-name cap, participation, cost model, PIT rules and the INV-13 purge/embargo discipline are untouched by this contract.
R14 (complexity): resolve_session_grid is O(n_panel_rows + n_sessions); window_opportunities is O(n_sessions * mean_breadth). Neither may scan the panel per session.
non_goals: Raising max_gross_exposure above 1.90 (physically bounded by cash-only ETF purchase, and INV-18 governs it).
Widening the capacity envelope: measured at 100.0B / 50.0B / 25.0B / 15.8B KRW required ADV, every wider envelope was equal or worse on both the full-sample curve and the 8 tournament windows.
Promoting sticky.mom60_vol_hysteresis. It is registered as a candidate only; promotion is decided by the new gate after the integrity fix, on re-measured artifacts.

scenarios.expected_behavior: A calendar session with no panel rows is excluded from the grid and reported in phantom; a panel date absent from the calendar is never added.
scenarios.test_skeleton:
from datetime import date

import polars as pl


def test_resolve_session_grid_drops_phantom_sessions() -> None:
    from src.backtest.session_grid import resolve_session_grid

    # Given: calendar claims 2026-06-03 is a session but the panel observes nothing that day
    sessions = [date(2026, 6, 2), date(2026, 6, 3), date(2026, 6, 4)]
    panel = pl.DataFrame(
        {
            "date": [date(2026, 6, 2), date(2026, 6, 4), date(2026, 6, 5)],
            "ticker": ["122630", "122630", "122630"],
            "close": [100.0, 110.0, 120.0],
        }
    )

    # When
    grid = resolve_session_grid(sessions, panel)

    # Then: phantom dropped, non-calendar panel date not added
    assert grid.sessions == (date(2026, 6, 2), date(2026, 6, 4))
    assert grid.phantom == (date(2026, 6, 3),)
    assert date(2026, 6, 5) not in grid.sessions

scenarios.expected_behavior: A session with no open/close prices for held shares neither duplicates nor destroys equity: equity_close equals the prior marked equity, shares and cash are unchanged, session_return is 0.0.
scenarios.test_skeleton:
from datetime import date


def test_transition_priceless_session_conserves_equity() -> None:
    from src.backtest.costs import CostConfig, CostModel
    from src.execution.ledger import PortfolioLedgerState, transition_portfolio_state
    from src.portfolio.intent import PortfolioIntent

    # Given: 1.0B KRW portfolio, 95% in X at 100,000 KRW, on a session with no prices at all
    prior = PortfolioLedgerState(cash=50_000_000.0, shares={"X": 9_500.0})
    intent = PortfolioIntent(kind="target", weights={"X": 0.95})

    # When
    result = transition_portfolio_state(
        prior_state=prior,
        intent=intent,
        decision_date=date(2026, 6, 2),
        prev_closes={"X": 100_000.0},
        opens={},
        closes={},
        cost_model=CostModel(CostConfig(commission_bps=0.0, slippage_bps=0.0)),
        adv_by_ticker={"X": 1e12},
        max_order_to_adv=0.01,
        exposure_limits=(0.95, 1.90, 0.05),
        leverage_multiples={"X": 2},
        execution=None,
        panel=None,
    )

    # Then: equity conserved, not duplicated (regression: was 1.0B cash while retaining 9,500 shares)
    assert result.equity_close == 1_000_000_000.0
    assert result.state.cash == 50_000_000.0
    assert result.state.shares == {"X": 9_500.0}
    assert result.session_return == 0.0
    assert result.fills == ()

scenarios.expected_behavior: carry_forward_marks takes the first finite positive price across the supplied maps in order and omits tickers that have none.
The ceiling is the best next-open to next-open return over the session's candidates; breadth counts candidates with usable endpoint prices; a session with no usable candidate yields ceiling None.

from datetime import date


def test_window_opportunities_ceiling_and_breadth() -> None:
    from src.tournament.attainability import window_opportunities

    # Given: 4 sessions, horizon 2 -> only window start index 0 is emittable (needs index 0+1+2 = 3)
    sessions = [date(2026, 1, 5), date(2026, 1, 6), date(2026, 1, 7), date(2026, 1, 8)]
    open_by_session = [

        {"A": 120.0, "B": 110.0},
        {"A": 150.0, "B": 110.0},
    ]

scenarios.expected_behavior: capture_rate conditions on windows where the threshold was attainable and fails closed to None (never 0.0) when the attainable count is below the minimum.
scenarios.test_skeleton:
from datetime import date


def test_capture_rate_returns_none_below_min_attainable() -> None:
    from src.tournament.attainability import WindowOpportunity, attainability_curve, capture_rate

    # Given: 4 windows, 2 of which had a >40% ceiling; the strategy captured 1 of those 2
    d = [date(2026, 1, i) for i in (5, 6, 7, 8)]
    opps = [
        WindowOpportunity(window_start=d[0], breadth=2, ceiling=0.80),
        WindowOpportunity(window_start=d[1], breadth=2, ceiling=0.50),
        WindowOpportunity(window_start=d[2], breadth=1, ceiling=0.10),
        WindowOpportunity(window_start=d[3], breadth=0, ceiling=None),
    ]
    returns = [0.60, 0.05, 0.02, 0.00]

    # When
    capture, n = capture_rate(returns, opps, 0.40, min_attainable=1)
    blocked, n_blocked = capture_rate(returns, opps, 0.40, min_attainable=5)
    curve = attainability_curve(opps, [0.40])

    # Then
    assert n == 2
    assert abs(capture - 0.5) < 1e-12
    assert blocked is None and n_blocked == 2
    assert abs(curve[0.40] - 0.5) < 1e-12

def test_resolve_promotion_status_insufficient_power() -> None:
    from src.tournament.champion_eval import is_promotable, resolve_promotion_status

    # Given / When: all gates pass but the paired sample cannot see a difference
    weak = resolve_promotion_status(
        aggressive_status="PASS",
        conservative_status="PASS",
        loyo_status="PASS",
        artifact_integrity=True,
        n_effective_discordant=2,
        min_effective_discordant=5,
    )
    strong = resolve_promotion_status(
        aggressive_status="PASS",
        conservative_status="PASS",
        loyo_status="PASS",
        artifact_integrity=True,
        n_effective_discordant=9,
        min_effective_discordant=5,
    )
    failed = resolve_promotion_status(
        aggressive_status="FAIL",
        conservative_status="PASS",
        loyo_status="PASS",
        artifact_integrity=True,
        n_effective_discordant=9,
        min_effective_discordant=5,
    )

    # Then
    assert weak == "INSUFFICIENT_POWER"
    assert strong == "PROMOTE"
    assert failed == "RESEARCH_ONLY"
    assert is_promotable(
        aggressive_status="PASS",
        conservative_status="PASS",
        loyo_status="PASS",
        artifact_integrity=True,
    ) is True

scenarios.test_skeleton:
import pytest


def test_discordant_window_mask_marks_differing_windows() -> None:
    from src.tournament.champion_eval import discordant_window_mask

    # Given: they differ only on session index 3
    cand = ["A", "A", "A", "B", "A", "A"]
    inc = ["A", "A", "A", "A", "A", "A"]

    # When: horizon 2 -> windows [0,2) [1,3) [2,4) [3,5) [4,6)
    mask = discordant_window_mask(cand, inc, horizon=2)

    # Then: only the windows covering index 3 are discordant
    assert mask == (False, False, True, True, False)

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        discordant_window_mask(["A"], ["A", "B"], horizon=1)

scenarios.expected_behavior: With abs_mom_exit=-0.10 a held position survives a mildly negative score but is cut below the exit bar; a flat book still requires a positive score to enter; a positive configured bar fails closed to 0.0.
scenarios.test_skeleton:
def test_abs_mom_cash_exit_bar_is_hysteretic() -> None:
    from src.portfolio.intent import CASH_INTENT
    from src.strategies.sticky.model import StickyLeaderConfig
    from src.strategies.sticky.overlays import apply_abs_mom_cash

    cfg = StickyLeaderConfig(abs_mom_cash=True, abs_mom_exit=-0.10)

    # Given a held position: -5% is above the -10% exit bar -> stay invested
    assert apply_abs_mom_cash({"A": -0.05}, cfg, held="A") == {"A": -0.05}
    # Below the exit bar -> cash
    assert apply_abs_mom_cash({"A": -0.15}, cfg, held="A") is CASH_INTENT
    # Flat book: entry bar stays at 0.0 regardless of abs_mom_exit
    assert apply_abs_mom_cash({"A": -0.05}, cfg, held=None) is CASH_INTENT
    assert apply_abs_mom_cash({"A": 0.05}, cfg, held=None) == {"A": 0.05}
    # Fail-closed: a positive exit bar is rejected back to 0.0
    bad = StickyLeaderConfig(abs_mom_cash=True, abs_mom_exit=0.20)
    assert apply_abs_mom_cash({"A": -0.01}, bad, held="A") is CASH_INTENT

scenarios.expected_behavior: The daily frame produced by a backtest contains no session that is absent from the panel, so the grid used by the engine is the observed intersection.
scenarios.test_skeleton:
from datetime import date

import polars as pl


def test_engine_run_excludes_phantom_sessions() -> None:
    from src.backtest.session_grid import resolve_session_grid

    # Given: the panel misses two mid-range calendar sessions
    calendar_sessions = [date(2026, 6, d) for d in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)]
    panel = pl.DataFrame(
        {
            "date": [date(2026, 6, 1), date(2026, 6, 2), date(2026, 6, 4)],
            "ticker": ["X", "X", "X"],
            "close": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0],
            "open": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0],
        }
    )

    # When
    grid = resolve_session_grid(calendar_sessions, panel)

    # Then: engine-facing grid never contains a priceless session
    panel_dates = set(panel["date"].to_list())
    assert set(grid.sessions) <= panel_dates
    assert grid.phantom == (date(2026, 6, 3), date(2026, 6, 5))
